nodeData.note: CC Antya 3.94–100 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. The series opens on the glories of Haridasa Thakura, who chanted before tulasi in the Benapola forest. Maharaj stresses that the process is simple and cheap — what is missing is desire, a clear goal and the right attitude — and teaches how to chant with Tulasi Devi and the name as persons. Questions bring out how pure devotees see the name, with the story of Srinivasa Acarya absorbed in Radha-Krishna's pastime. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: The chapter: glories of Haridasa Thakura
children.note: Caitanya-caritamrta, Antya-lila chapter 3, on the glories of Haridasa Thakura, read in Vrindavan with Hindi translation. This first class covers verses 94 to 100.
Mahaprabhu delights in glorifying his devotees, and Haridasa's qualities are said to be beyond any full count.
The author notes that Vrindavana dasa Thakura described some of Haridasa's qualities in Caitanya-mangala, and that one speaks of them only for self-purification.
The narration begins with Haridasa leaving home and living for a time in the forest of Benapola.
The verse describes Haridasa's life of chanting before tulasi day and night; Srila Prabhupada's purport turns it into a practical lesson for members of the movement.

children.topic: Simple: a plant, a seat, a tongue
children.note:
Maharaj asks what a tulasi plant costs — fifty rupees — and whether anyone here lacks fifty rupees. No gold or diamonds are required: a plant, a place to sit, a tongue and ears. So Prabhupada calls the process simple.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:49 (auto-transcript): “We have tulasi plants. How much tulasi costs? Tulasi plants. How much tulasi costs? 50 rupees. Anyone here doesn't have 50 rupees? Anyone? We have 50 rupees. That means that it is possible.”

The difficulty is not the process but our lack of desire. Ignorance makes the desire weak, the tongue heavy and the mind restless; goodness is peaceful and has time. — “no desire to do it.”

🎙 Maharaj at 26:57 (auto-transcript): “The problem is no desire to do it. Why no desire? The mode of ignorance is prominent. Because of the mode of ignorance,”

Where Haridasa lived there was a very dangerous snake whose poisonous breath could be felt from a distance, yet he sat and chanted peacefully, not even noticing it.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:38 (auto-transcript): “Not even a place for Harada Sakur, where he stays, a very dangerous snake, the vapo alone, without biting, very dangerous. You have seen the refinery, you have seen the refinery, that is exactly the power of this snake, the wap of this snake is like that, from distance, you…”

Haridasa is an internal devotee, connected with Krishna, so his senses are not outside. Ours are mostly outside: we see the snake, the poison, and get distracted. — “All his senses are turned inside.”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:11 (auto-transcript): “Haritās is an internal devotee. All his senses are turned inside. In other words, he is connected with Krishna So his senses are not outside Most of his senses are outside Therefore we see the environment We see the snake”

That is why Prabhupada says we cannot imitate Haridasa, but we can follow him — at least with our sixteen rounds.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:57 (auto-transcript): “We see the poison, and we get distracted from it, and this is the difference, so Prabhupada says we cannot imitate it, we can follow, for his minimum 16 and 20. Shri Rastakudegh Goswami back bottom sorry”

Quoting the instruction to chant in the footsteps of the previous teachers, Maharaj says the standard is how our acaryas chanted, not how we happen to be chanting. — “We should chant the way they chanted.”

🎙 Maharaj at 31:55 (auto-transcript): “He said, Harinama Anukirtanam. He should chant the holy name after the ways of all this. As our acharyas chant. Not as we are chanting. We should chant the way they chanted. How did Haridash Thakur chant?”

children.topic: Why the name was sweet for Haridasa
children.note:
He sat before tulasi, seeing nothing else and not worrying about the time — not because he had no office to go to, but because of his qualities. He knew the position of the holy name, its benefit, and what he was looking for.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:39 (auto-transcript): “How did Haridash Thakur chant? I was chanting. Sitting, Tulsi plant, you don't see anything, not worrying about the time, it is not because Harida was not going to the office, it is because of the qualities he has.”

Most of us chant, but not for love of Godhead, so we cannot expect the experience and success Haridasa had.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:05 (auto-transcript): “The majority of devotees are chanting Hare Krishna Mantra. Not because we want to go to Godhead. It's not for Godhead. We are not doing different reasons for God's sake. Therefore, we will not have the experience and the success that Haridas could have.”

For Haridasa the name was sweet: he took full shelter, the name was with him, and they were intimate, because he wanted only pure love of Godhead.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:51 (auto-transcript): “The holy name for Haridas was very sweet. Because of his consciousness, he was one with the name, taking full shelter. Therefore, the name was with Haridas. They were together, very intimate, that is how Harita Sakura was chanting, he knows the whole name, he knows what is…”

Being told to chant and simply chanting is not enough. Maharaj urges everyone to define what they expect from chanting, and to check it, or progress will be difficult. — “We should know why we want to chant”

🎙 Maharaj at 35:50 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, we should sincerely define what is our goal by chanting the Holiness. We should define what is our goal, what are we expecting. We have been told that chant Hare Krishna mantra Okay, so we are chanting”

Chanting before Tulasi Devi means Narayana is present, and Narayana is never alone — he is always with his devotees. So we are in the association of elevated personalities, and should consciously see ourselves chanting with them.

Maharaj has the room repeat a prayer he learned from another devotee: I am the most fortunate person in the universe because I have Krishna's name, which connects me with the Lord. What else could we want? — “I am the most fortunate person in the universe”

🎙 Maharaj at 38:48 (auto-transcript): “Mahatma Prabhu said please repeat I am the most fortunate person in the universe I am the most fortunate person in the universe because I have the holy name of Krishna which connects me with the Supreme Lord. So chanting the holy name means what? We are connected with the…”

Give the best of our life to the holy name, and pray to Haridasa: as you chanted and attained pure love, bless me to chant that way.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:10 (auto-transcript): “Make prayer to Haridashtha. As you have chanted. I attended the ultimate, professional chanting, pure of our Godhead. May you bless me to chant this way. and then beautiful God here this message we read”

Mahaprabhu glorifies Haridasa because of the way he chanted — he captured the Lord by the name. Without the correct attitude, even sixty-four rounds a day bring little result; with a pure, respectful attitude the result comes.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:57 (auto-transcript): “Chaitanya Mahaprabhu is glorifying her in us Because of the way he chanted the holy name. He captured the Lord by chanting the holy name. The Lord is very pleased with him. So, Shri Bhagawan Chaitanya Mahaprabhu Atyantya Prashanam Is the attitude of Haridash Thakur Let's have…”

A second prayer to repeat: when I chant, I chant. It means full absorption, with nothing between us and the holy name. — “Nothing in between us and the Holy Name.”

🎙 Maharaj at 42:12 (auto-transcript): “another prayer from Mahatma Prabhu Please repeat. When I chant, I chant. Does it make sense? When I chant, I chant. Means what? Nothing in between us and the Holy Name. Nothing in between us and the holy name, nothing.”

Because the holy name is a person, he knows what is in our mind and responds to it. So give him full attention, just as we cook when we cook and eat when we eat.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:21 (auto-transcript): “The holy name is a person. Therefore he knows What is in our mind He knows And he will respond to that Therefore Let us chant when we chant Give full attention to the Holy Name Not in between. If we want to cook.”

Three questions about Tulasi Devi and how pure devotees see the holy name.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:05 (auto-transcript): “there is a possibility to ask like, why you say, because sometimes you concentrate on the ordinary, I have the habit to close the eyes. But then, one place to say that, in front of pure devotee, if you close your eyes, it does not take so much since something that sources are…”

children.topic: Q1 · Eyes closed, or on Tulasi?
children.note:
A devotee who closes her eyes to concentrate asks why Maharaj recommends gazing at Tulasi Devi, as one looks at a pure devotee.

🎙 Question from the floor at 45:05 (auto-transcript): “there is a possibility to ask like, why you say, because sometimes you concentrate on the ordinary, I have the habit to close the eyes. But then, one place to say that, in front of pure devotee, if you close your eyes, it does not take so much since something that sources are…”

By looking we connect, and their energy flows to us and gives strength. If we are not consciously looking, the mind wanders and the current does not flow.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:43 (auto-transcript): “By looking at them, we connect with them. What is your experience? Flow to us. If you are not watching, the mind will go somewhere. And then, this condition. The current will not flow to us. But if we are consciously looking,”

Krishna blessed Tulasi to remain in this world so that people could easily reach pure love for him through her; hence she is worshipped throughout the universe. Chant with her consciously and we progress faster.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:59 (auto-transcript): “When Krishna, Tundra Krishna was ending the person between himself and Tulsi, When Krishna gave her a blessing. He should stay here in this material world. So people will easily attain pure love for me by Gashvishish.”

children.topic: Q2 · I only see a plant
children.note:
A devotee feels the presence of the deities but sees Tulasi only as a plant.

🎙 Question from the floor at 49:47 (auto-transcript): “I can see that they are living, but Tulsi, I cannot get so much same energy, the same consciousness as the Kewati Vulti. I see it as a plant. Yes. Tell him. When I look at Tulsi, I see two things. I am seeing the plant”

children.topic: See the plant and the person
children.note:
Maharaj sees two things: the plant and the person. Small as she is beside a banyan tree, she is powerful; we should practise seeing the person whose body is the plant. — “we should see the person whose body is the plant.”

🎙 Maharaj at 50:28 (auto-transcript): “When I look at Tulsi, I see two things. I am seeing the plant and I see the person. The beauty is sweet. Not just the plant alone. Yes, somebody plant all over here. Banyan tree, bigot and Tulsi Devi.”

children.topic: Q3 · How do pure devotees chant?
children.note:
What does it mean that pure devotees are so absorbed when they chant?

🎙 Question from the floor at 52:08 (auto-transcript): “So the first question is that when you say that the pure devotees are very mature, so what do you tell us? What kind of name is this very mature? How does it feel mature?”

As with tulasi, they see both the syllables and the person of the name, and Krishna sits listening to their chanting. They are not in the material world but with him in the spiritual world, where there is no anxiety.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:01 (auto-transcript): “The pure devotees, they see, like we are talking about the plant, they see their name and they place their name, the sea boat. Bhagawan ke Shuddha Bhakti, jab naam ka jab karte hain, we naam akchhar ko dekhte hain, uske saath saath naam vyakti ko bhi dekhte hain, jayise tulsi…”

Before his deity worship Srinivasa Acarya entered, in his spiritual form, Radha and Krishna's water play in the Yamuna. Radharani lost a tiny ornament in the dark water, and he helped search until it was found. All day he sat motionless; the household grew alarmed, until Virabhadra Gosvami entered the same pastime and assured them he was not dead.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:27 (auto-transcript): “There is a pastime. You want to look at the consciousness of pure good. They are wanting to see what is happening in Narutandashthaku.”

Etiquette asks that we sit and eat mindfully. Eating carelessly leads to offences to prasadam and makes others offend too; eaten with anxiety, even plenty of food does not nourish.

🎙 Maharaj at 66:10 (auto-transcript): “Why? Attitude. If you eat, etiquette demands which you sit and eat. The first reason is attitude. His Holiness Bachchan Maharaj calls it mindful eating. If we are not mindfully eating,”

In the same way, approaching the holy name with pride is the wrong attitude: then the name is not there, only its letters. — “The name will not be there, only the alphabet you get”

🎙 Maharaj at 68:45 (auto-transcript): “The same way, if our attitude towards chanting is, to us chanting is, we are offending the name. So how will we get delivered? Not possible. attitude is very important, how we understand the name, how much we approach the name, we approach the name with pride, it's wrong…”

The ten offences describe how our mind should be towards the name. A careful, respectful person cannot offend anyone — others may envy him — but a bad attitude creates havoc for ourselves and others.

🎙 Maharaj at 69:59 (auto-transcript): “But when we discuss the offenses to avoid the world chanting the name, what are we talking about? Attitude So when we are talking about these 10 names, what is it? How should our name be our mind and soul be? These are the 10 names. The person who is very careful, who is very…”

nodeData.note: CC Antya 3.101 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. One verse — Haridasa begging a little food at brahmanas' homes — opens a whole class on what devotees eat and accept. Maharaj explains that such saints visit homes only to bless and preach, that gifts and food carry the giver's karma, and that knowledge shows itself as renunciation. He asks why ISKCON is called a kitchen religion rather than vairagya-vidya, and answers questions on invitations and re-cooked offerings. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The verse tells how Haridasa maintained his body with a little food from brahmanas' houses and was honoured by everyone around. Srila Prabhupada's purport draws out where devotees should take their food.

Maharaj says Haridasa did not really go for food. Like Sukadeva Gosvami, such saints visit householders only to preach to them; they have all their nourishment with them. — “Only to preach to them”

🎙 Maharaj at 09:17 (auto-transcript): “Shri La Haidash Thakur actually it is not for begging for food. That is pretense. The only reason Nama Acharya Haridasa Kura This is Goswami Shukadeva Goswami They go to the houses or the house of us Only to preach to them”

Raghunatha dasa Gosvami took almost nothing — a little buttermilk — yet suffered indigestion. The cause was that Srimati Radharani was feeding him. What would such a person need from a householder's kitchen?

🎙 Maharaj at 10:41 (auto-transcript): “We heard about Raghunath Das Goswami. He was constipated. Butter milk will constipate somebody. Butter milk. You know the quantity Haridaz was taking? That will constipate somebody.”

Gaura Kisora dasa Babaji went nowhere; when hungry he took a little Ganga mud on his finger, ate it and went on chanting. If such a saint visits a home, it is only to preach.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:15 (auto-transcript): “Personality is like Gaur Kishoda Babaji Maharaj. He doesn't go anywhere. When he's hungry, this finger this finger he will take a mud from Ganga like this so he will eat and he will continue what would he do in someone's house he is only to preach So, Prabhupada has warned…”

Prabhupada warns that taking food from others means sharing their qualities; Maharaj adds that we also become part of their karma.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:59 (auto-transcript): “So, Prabhupada has warned all of us, if we take food from the houses of others such as We shall have to share the qualities of those from whom we take arms. So we will also become a part of the karma of such people. Kurkishwota Baba Ji Maharaj. Shilagor Kshwota. Jagadant,…”

Jagannatha dasa Babaji received a donation of one rupee and had his servant return it: it was loaded with karma and he could not bear it. Maharaj turns to the room — and you carry millions of them. Are we ready to share that load? — “I cannot bear to take it.”

🎙 Maharaj at 13:52 (auto-transcript): “Jagannath Da Baba Ji Maharaj. Vaishnamasar Bhuma, Jagannath Da Baba Ji Maharaj. Jagannath, he got a donation of one rupee. He got a donation of one rupee. I told the servant, return it. Please, please, go and give it back. This one rupee is fully loaded with karma.”

Our process is vairagya-vidya, renunciation and knowledge. How do you know someone is knowledgeable? By how detached he is from material thinking — and by his gentleness, for knowledge does not make one proud. — “A knowledgeable person is not proud.”

🎙 Maharaj at 15:45 (auto-transcript): “ready? Prabhupada said here, our process is vairagya vidya. The process of vairagya and knowledge. How do you know someone has knowledge? What is the proof? This person has knowledge. This person is knowledgeable. How can you say it? What is the proof? What can you say? What…”

Knowledge winds this way and that, and many quotations can be taken in any direction; bhakti goes straight.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:39 (auto-transcript): “So, this current movement, we always, you know, in our system, in our system, if you, you know how knowledge works, knowledge, you know how it works, knowledge is like this, it's like this, it's like this, it's like this, it's like this, it's like this. Bhakti is straight…”

Everyone quotes Prabhupada calling ISKCON a kitchen religion; how many lectures quote him calling it vairagya-vidya? What we prominently preach is what we become — we do not want renunciation, so we preach food.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:09 (auto-transcript): “Srila Prabhupada said Iskand is a kitchen religion. That has been loudly proclaimed. How many of us have quoted this? How many lectures have you heard this? The Iskorn movement is a part of Vairagya Vidya. Have you heard this in any lecture? No.”

Prabhupada's purport is clean and plain; it is our lives that are crooked. There is nothing confusing in the point that a devotee must be careful about what he eats. — “Hare Krishna devotee should be careful with what we eat.”

🎙 Maharaj at 21:29 (auto-transcript): “When we look at Prabhupada's purpose, what I see is that everything is clean, but our life is crooked, our life is different from what Prabhupada has put in this purpose. A lot of confusion, but what is confusion here? What is confusion here?”

Maharaj recalls Mahaprabhu announcing that anyone who wanted to invite him must pay an enormous sum. The devotees despaired — none of them had it. Then he explained: whoever chants one hundred thousand names is qualified to feed him.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:13 (auto-transcript): “He said, one day, Chitanya Mahaprabhu told the devotees, from today onward, anyone who wants to invite me to the house, you have to pay 10,000 coins, 100,000, 100,000, all”

Chanting purifies the consciousness; food cooked in that consciousness is fit to be offered to the salagrama, and a devotee can happily accept it.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:49 (auto-transcript): “What is the purport of that? 100,000 names One who chants 100,000 names The consciousness will be purified Without purifying the consciousness When one cooks It is suitable to be offered to Salagamshila Then, a devotee should take that happily. Any house without deity, please…”

Do not eat in a house without deity worship — and even in houses with deities, be careful.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:31 (auto-transcript): “Any house without deity, please don't eat in an house. Not all adults. Even the houses that have did this, please, be careful. Some years ago, we were on a safari tour. And we went to Malda. So, we were there for a few days. And the servant was pushing me to take prasad.”

children.topic: The plate he could not wash
children.note:
On a preaching tour in Malda, among devotees with shining threads, Maharaj's servant pressed him to take prasadam there; he quietly declined. Later the servant searched far for a place to wash the plates — he had seen meat in that kitchen. Maharaj looks at him: you wanted me to eat where you could not even wash a plate?

🎙 Maharaj at 25:56 (auto-transcript): “Some years ago, we were on a safari tour. And we went to Malda. So, we were there for a few days. And the servant was pushing me to take prasad. I said, no, no, no. The whole of this place is full of devotees. All initiated devotees, their thread is silver.”

In Nectar of Instruction Rupa Gosvami speaks of the one who chants nicely. Maharaj asks why he added that word: not just to chant, but to do it well. — “Devotion has quality, and we have to look for the quality.”

🎙 Maharaj at 29:28 (auto-transcript): “One of the verses in the Lecture of Instruction, Rupa Goswami says, the essence of all advice is that Wants who nicely chant the holy name. Why he didn't say wants to chant the holy name? Why he didn't say that? It's a complete English, right? Wants who chant the holy name of…”

Everyone knows the leaf, flower, fruit and water verse; Maharaj points to its last word. The items are available to anyone — Krishna looks for the consciousness of the one offering. We are a society for Krishna consciousness.

Haridasa goes to Vaishnava homes to benefit the householders, not from hunger: his spiritual body is nourished by the holy name alone.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:06 (auto-transcript): “Haridash Thakurji is going to the houses of Vaishnavas. And they will take something just to benefit the householders. Not because he is hungry. Haridash Thakur doesn't have a hungry body. He has a spiritual body that is spiritually being nourished. The holy name nourishes…”

children.topic: We want to eat — eat nicely
children.note:
We are not on his level and we do want to eat; then let us at least eat nicely, avoiding needless luxury.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:05 (auto-transcript): “Yes, we are not on that level. We want to eat, but eat nicely. Therefore, all devotees are warned not to live unnecessarily No serious lives are the cost of others. As far as possible, this should be avoided.”

Falldowns are happening, Maharaj says, so we should be careful in everything we do.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:45 (auto-transcript): “It is happening. Therefore, we should be careful about everything that we do. We should be careful. How do we balance the relationships that we have with devotees?”

Two questions about eating in devotees' homes and about offerings.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:04 (auto-transcript): “How do we balance the relationships that we have with devotees?”

children.topic: Q1 · Accepting invitations from close devotees?
children.note:
Close devotees invite us and cook what we like. How do we keep these relationships while eating nicely?

🎙 Question from the floor at 36:04 (auto-transcript): “How do we balance the relationships that we have with devotees?”

children.topic: Not at the cost of our sadhana
children.note:
It is better not to please people at the cost of our own spiritual life. Once in a while can be accommodated, not regularly. A host who is a devotee should know what to offer — why cook a hundred preparations at eleven at night?

🎙 Maharaj at 38:03 (auto-transcript): “It is better not to to please people at the course of our own spiritual life.”

Our consciousness is not changing because we minimise the process in the name of preaching. The purpose of coming together is to support each other.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:59 (auto-transcript): “We are in Krishna consciousness but our consciousness is not changing because we are minimizing the process in the name of preaching. It shouldn't be like that.”

children.topic: Not as strong as they are
children.note:
A friend once phoned: after a meeting the leaders were feasting on food cooked by non-devotees. Maharaj advised him to tell them he was not as strong as they were and would eat at the temple — and it worked. — “you are not as strong as they are”

🎙 Maharaj at 42:10 (auto-transcript): “A few years ago, one of my friends is here in this class. So he called me. Some leaders have come for a meeting. and at the end of the meeting he prasad cooked by non-devotives all the leaders are feasting”

Maharaj says anything that enters his mouth reacts immediately, and he wonders at those who can eat anything and feel nothing.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:14 (auto-transcript): “I always wondered when I see how people eat and feel comfortable. Anything, anything that enter my mouth, it will react, you know, immediately. Anything, anything that I put in my mouth, I will know exactly what is going on. I also wonder how we have so many transdental…”

Some cook the leftover offered bhoga into a new dish and offer it again the next day. Is this authorised?

🎙 Question from the floor at 46:26 (auto-transcript): “they will offer bhoga to the Lord, then part of it will remain. Then tomorrow they will cook it again and make a new dish out of it. Like kind of new bhoga and then they will offer again. So I just wanted to know is this authorized or is this a bogus practice? My question is…”

Maharaj answers in one word — laziness, the mode of ignorance. Those in goodness do things straight. We claim no time for Krishna yet find time for maya; make time for Krishna and there is none left for maya. — “Better to have time for Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 47:15 (auto-transcript): “Laziness. Noting else, laziness. A mode of ignorance. Ignorance. Those in satyagun, they will not do like that. Everything is straight, straight. We don't have time for Krishna, but we don't have time for Maya.”

nodeData.note: CC Antya 3.102–106 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Ramacandra Khan, envious of Haridasa's fame, plots to ruin him with prostitutes. Maharaj explains why pure devotees are always attacked, from outside and inside, and why they stay calm — Haridasa, Prahlada, Srila Prabhupada in court, Narottama dasa Thakura's disciples — and draws a surprising lesson from the one 'uncultured' prostitute who went and was delivered. Questions cover past-life connections with the guru and how needless culture covers bhakti. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: A local landholder, envious of Vaishnavas, cannot bear the honour shown to Haridasa and looks for ways to disgrace him; finding no fault in his character, he turns to prostitutes. Prabhupada's purport compares him to critics of the Krishna consciousness movement.

Demons do not want Krishna consciousness because it exposes their deviation.

🎙 Maharaj at 07:07 (auto-transcript): “Demons do not want Krishna consciousness. Demons should not. They don't want. Because Krishna consciousness exposes the deviation. Effective.”

The policeman simply walks his way, yet the thief feels insecure on seeing him. Pure devotees are like that police: their purity threatens the asuras, so history shows them always seriously attacked — one acarya had to flee from Sri Rangam to Melkote. — “Shuddha Bhakti threatens the life of the Asuras.”

🎙 Maharaj at 07:52 (auto-transcript): “Sees a policeman. How does he feel? The policeman is going his way. The thief sees him. He feels insecure. In the same way, the police of Krishna consciousness, the pure devotees, Shuddha Bhakti threatens the life of the Asuras.”

Maharaj asks who has noticed that in some South Indian temples Lord Vishnu is placed behind Lord Siva. A Siva temple is fine, but putting Vishnu at the back is an offence — it is calling for a fight.

🎙 Maharaj at 09:28 (auto-transcript): “If you are very observant, when you go to South Indian temples, you see Lord Vishnu is at the back of Lord Shiva's temple. Did you see that or not? Did you see? He didn't see. No. Anyway, I'm not blaming you because you're trying to tell people.”

Preach pure Krishna consciousness and you will face serious problems, both outside and inside. Prabhupada succeeded, and met a lot of opposition.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:07 (auto-transcript): “If you are preaching pure Krishna consciousness, you will have serious problems. Both outside and inside. So proper is successful in presenting Krishna consciousness. A lot of oppositions. This year. One devotee from Gaudiya Mahārāj, he called his Solanus Bhaktira Sāyana…”

This year someone from another Gaudiya group told one of Prabhupada's disciples to tell his guru to change his name. Maharaj: go to Goloka and tell him yourself. Though Prabhupada is not physically here, they still send him their envy.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:51 (auto-transcript): “One devotee from Gaudiya Mahārāj, he called his Solanus Bhaktira Sāyana Sāgara Swāi Mahārāj. Come, come. Tell your Guru, Prabhupāj, to change his name. He is not Prabhupada, only Prabhupada is our guru, he is not Prabhupada. Even though he is not physically here, they are…”

Every religious organisation has two groups — those practising nicely and those not — and they always fight. There are many Ramacandra Khans in our own temples, not just outside.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:26 (auto-transcript): “It is happening outside. It's also happening inside. This is normal in all religious organizations. Every religious organization you would find two groups, always. Those who are practicing nicely, and those are not practicing nicely. They will always fight. It's always there.…”

Some say Prabhupada's Gita is too heavy and want a light one. Maharaj answers that the heavy one made you a devotee, so it has potency; how many devotees would a light one make? That is an attack on the movement. — “The heavy Bhagavad Gita made you a devotee.”

🎙 Maharaj at 16:13 (auto-transcript): “Srila Prabhupada Bhagavad Gita is too heavy. Let us have a light Bhagavad Gita. What is that? The heavy Bhagavad Gita made you a devotee. That means it has potency. That it made you a devotee. So, when you want to make a live Gita, how many devotees that would make? How many?…”

When we feel disturbed by devotees who practise nicely, that too is an attack on the movement.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:11 (auto-transcript): “When we feel disturbed with devotees who are practicing nicely, what is that? It's an attack also on the movement. But Haridash Thakur has not been disturbed yet. He does not even see Ramachandra come. For him, he does not resist. because it is not a problem for him. Hadidash…”

Haridasa does not even see Ramacandra Khan and does not resist, because for him it is no problem. He disturbs the atheists, but they cannot disturb him — that is how we recognise a pure devotee. — “the atheists are no problem for Hadidash.”

🎙 Maharaj at 17:23 (auto-transcript): “But Haridash Thakur has not been disturbed yet. He does not even see Ramachandra come. For him, he does not resist. because it is not a problem for him. Hadidash would become a problem for the atheists, but the atheists are no problem for Hadidash.”

children.topic: Calm in distress, not only peace
children.note:
After a devotee reads a Gita purport aloud, Maharaj underlines it: a serious, sincere devotee stays calm, quiet and patient in distressful conditions, not just peaceful ones. Ramacandra Khan is restless; Haridasa is peaceful.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:51 (auto-transcript): “That is a serious and sincere devotee. In the middle of distressful condition, not as peaceful condition, distressful condition, he remain calm, quiet, and peaceful. That is a sincere and serious devotee. Ramachandr Khan is restless, disturbed,”

The same picture: Prahlada serene, his father trembling with anger.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:42 (auto-transcript): “The same thing you will see through it, Pralad Maharaj. Pralad was peaceful, calm, very serene, but here a Katsipu trembling in anger. But when Kashyapu was atyant vuchlith, he was closed. That's a devotee. One time. Is someone who was sued to court?”

When Prabhupada was taken to court he did not lament or ask why no one supported him. He stayed calm and bold, called for others to come and defend their religion, and asked that every lawyer be given a Bhagavad-gita. He won the case. — “let them read it before we start the case.”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:23 (auto-transcript): “One time. Is someone who was sued to court? Is there not anxiety for Prabhupada? Is there not anxiety for Prabhupada? Is there not anxiety? Anxiety. What was the proper reaction? Calm. Peaceful. Then he called Gopal Krishna Gopal Krishna Maharaj. Call all the Gopal Krishna…”

Narottama dasa Thakura, not born a brahmana, had brahmana disciples, and the brahmana community was furious. Krishna had his own arrangement.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:05 (auto-transcript): “What of Narottan Dashthakura? Right? Narottan? Yes? Is Narottan? Is Narottan? Yes. He had disciples who were Brahmanas. He is not a Brahmana. So the Brahmana community became angry. He's going to spoil our religion. How can he initiate Brahmana?”

A proud scholar who went about defeating everyone challenged Rupa and Sanatana Gosvamis. Rather than waste time, they simply signed that he had defeated them — no false ego, happy and satisfied.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:17 (auto-transcript): “One devotee, I forgot, I'm trying to remember. He was a Brahmana. And very, very scholarly. And he became a gyan. He was going around challenging people and defeating people. I became very proud. He came to Rupa Sanatana Goswami. Remember his name? Yes, thank you. Correct.”

Boasting of the signature, he met Jiva Gosvami, who corrected his ego, made him humble and a devotee — then brought him to his uncles rather than initiating him himself. Maharaj asks: what was wrong in that?

🎙 Maharaj at 28:16 (auto-transcript): “And he met Jeeva Goswami. Jeeva Goswami saw him. And he started boasting. See uncle's signature. See. You are small boys. No need to talk to you, small boys. Srajima Goswami following the Vaishnava etiquette hearing”

On the way to take initiation from Narottama he came to a king to whom complaints against Narottama were being made, and kept quiet about his guru. Narottama's learned disciples disguised themselves as humble traders and defeated the king's pandits, and in the end all became Narottama's disciples.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:03 (auto-transcript): “So, before getting to Nautam Dasekura, he came to the king, who was Shivaj. And then people came to report Nathundas Thakur to him. This is a full story. We are only hearing the short, short one. This is a full story. So they were talking to the king to punish, to defame…”

Plans to disturb devotees have gone on ever since, but sincere devotees win because Krishna is in their heart. — “Devotees are always victorious, never defeated”

🎙 Maharaj at 35:01 (auto-transcript): “The plan to always disturb devotees have been going on since then in Moria. Devotees are always victorious, never defeated, because Krishna is in their heart, they are sincere, serious devotees of Krishna. so they are always perfect so Ramachandrakhan said”
Ramacandra Khan tells the prostitutes to find a way to break Haridasa's vows of austerity.

Devotees disturb no one, so why are others disturbed? Before a pure person our contamination comes out. The fortunate surrender; the unfortunate become envious — it is the guilt of impurity. — “A guilt of impurity.”

🎙 Maharaj at 36:24 (auto-transcript): “This is how the demons think. Devotees are peacefully practicing their Christian consciousness. They are not disturbing anybody. But why are they disturbed? Because of our contaminations, when we come before a pure person, all our narratives will come out.”

In the Second Canto Narada, surprised to see Brahma worshipping, asks if he is not the Supreme. Brahma says no — and maya cannot touch him because he holds Krishna's lotus feet with great zeal, that is, seriously. Pure devotees are fixed like that.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:22 (auto-transcript): “In the second canto of Bhagavatam, there is a conversation between Narada and Lord Brahma. Narada Muni was surprised to see Brahma worshipping Krishna. So, Pralamanji asks, Are you not Krishna? Are you not the Supreme God?”

children.topic: You would still not be Haridasa
children.note:
Even if Haridasa's austerity were spoiled, Ramacandra Khan would not become Haridasa; he would remain envious and impure.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:01 (auto-transcript): “so Ramachandrakhan called prostitutes go and spoil Harajar Sakura as austerity Yes, if Harida Sakura austerity is poured, will you become Harida? You will still be Ramachandaka, not Haridas. With the envy. Because of the impurities. So, what was the response of the prostitutes?”

Maharaj raises a point rarely discussed. Some of the prostitutes, cultured and principled, refused — they had no business with sadhus. One uncultured woman agreed and promised results in a few days. She went, and she was delivered; the cultured ones stayed behind.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:51 (auto-transcript): “There is something which we don't discuss and I want to discuss it today. Some of the prostitutes said, we are prostitutes but we don't have business with sadhus foolish people”

Which was best? The one who got association. Whatever our situation, we need to go to the sadhu; even if we come to harm them, they deliver us. — “whatever our situation is, we need to go to Sadhu.”

🎙 Maharaj at 45:44 (auto-transcript): “Question is the best. The one who got association, the one who got association, got delivered. What is the lesson we should get? What is the lesson? Let's be uncultured. We should become uncultured people. All uncultured people got to Haridas. All uncultured people, did they…”

Culture alone does not give Krishna consciousness, and adding needless culture to bhakti has a devastating effect. Regulative principles are given to fit us into bhakti, not to replace it.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:53 (auto-transcript): “Necessary culture cannot give one Krishna consciousness. we are adding on this is a culture to Krishna consciousness it's having a very heavy devastating effect is it true or not? Unnecessary culture is affecting our Krishna consciousness Krishna consciousness is our both…”

Two questions from the floor.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:25 (auto-transcript): “Very nice. Some are connected from past. some are joining now those who are connected from the past their relationship with their guru is very very strong”

The question itself is not audible; Maharaj answers that some disciples are connected from the past and some are joining now.

🎙 Question from the floor at 49:34 (auto-transcript): “Some are connected from past. some are joining now those who are connected from the past their relationship with their guru is very very strong very strong those who are just beginning”

Those connected from the past have a very strong relationship with their guru; newcomers' bond is still growing. A disciple once spoke to him in his own language during japa, in a country he had never visited. Narottama, Srinivasa, Syamananda and Lokanatha Gosvami were likewise connected from the past and came for our benefit.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:43 (auto-transcript): “one day I told one disciple in the morning we were doing japa and she was speaking my language so I have not been to my country before different country because she was speaking my language so I told her this morning you were speaking my language to me Do you want to sound in…”

children.topic: Q2 · How does culture cover bhakti?
children.note:
In what ways do we cover bhakti with culture, and how can we be direct?

🎙 Question from the floor at 53:14 (auto-transcript): “Like if you could tell us various ways in which we cover bhakti with culture or are direct with bhakti, from bhakti, because of the so-called question. So, my question is that, Maharaj Ji, we have told you that, in order to do more and more, we do not want to do much with…”

A godbrother once said Krishna consciousness is not our culture. But a culture of eating stale, fermented food is the mode of ignorance; we may act at our level, but must rise to goodness and to transcendence.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:16 (auto-transcript): “This Krishna consciousness is not our culture. Our culture is to remain ditty. Eat fermented food, which is a motto of ignorance. which is also in the Bhagavatam. Persons in a mode of goodness”

If culture says marry only a brahmana, and the choice is a non-devotee brahmana or a devotee — bhakti is better. That is what he means by unnecessary culture: a Vaishnava is superior to a brahmana.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:31 (auto-transcript): “I want to give another one, if I said my culture, I should marry only Brahmana, that's culture and you don't have that I say devotee but you have that I say Karami.”

Two people sitting at home look the same, one with a ticket and one without; the difference shows at the airport. A devotee fixed in practice, though not yet pure, has the guarantee of success and is better than a learned non-devotee brahmana.

nodeData.note: CC Antya 3.107–122 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. The prostitute comes to Haridasa's cottage night after night, and he keeps asking her to wait and hear the holy name until his rounds are done. Maharaj shows Haridasa as the full ocean of Gita 2.70, her words as subtle weapons, and his response as pure compassion: he sees only someone Krishna sent to be delivered. The pure name transforms her, and a question on lust during sadhana is answered: never finish chanting. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The plot is set: a constable is to follow and arrest Haridasa, but the prostitute wants to go alone first. Dressed attractively, she bows to the tulasi and to Haridasa and sits at his door.
She praises his youth and beauty and pleads her desire for him.
Haridasa agrees, asking her to sit and hear the holy name until he finishes chanting; she waits until dawn and leaves.
She reports to Ramacandra Khan and returns the next night; Haridasa apologises and repeats his promise.
Sitting at the door, she begins to imitate his chanting. Prabhupada's purport explains how a Vaishnava delivers a fallen soul.
Maharaj sees Haridasa fulfilling a Gita verse: the person undisturbed by desires, like the ocean that rivers keep entering yet stays still.

The devotee is not disturbed because he is full — there is no space for anything, not even a beautiful, attractive person.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:54 (auto-transcript): “the devotee is not disturbed by such desires because of his fullness. The devotee is not desired because he is full, full, no space for anything, not even a beautiful and attractive human.”

A full cup cannot take anything more; an empty one can. All our agitations come from emptiness — a lack of Krishna consciousness in our lives.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:10 (auto-transcript): “Haridash is full to make Krishna consciously therefore there was no space if a cup is full you cannot add anything if the cup is empty you can put something more in one sense all agitations”

Haridasa was full and satisfied, and Prabhupada calls that the proof of a Krishna conscious person.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:07 (auto-transcript): “Krishna bhauna mat ki kami hai humare jeevan mein Haydash Thakurji Poon the Tushta the that is the proof of a man in Krishna consciousness he is fool or Shila Prabhupada ji bolte hai yehi pramadikta hai yehi bhakt ki ki wap poon Krishna bhauna bhaavit hota hai so the…”

She speaks sweetly, but the sound coming from her is a weapon — not a gross one but a subtle one.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:31 (auto-transcript): “so the prostitute is speaking very nicely or vaha vaisya you don't know what is happening she was not always speaking the sound that is coming from her is a weapon not a gross weapon it is a subtle weapon But in the sense of aftar, Vidhishthir Maharaj Ji was told by Shri…”

Vidura told Yudhisthira that as a ksatriya he knew physical weapons, but subtler ones are more dangerous. On the road he was going: do not sleep like a goat, sleep like a cat — stay alert. — “Don't sleep like a goat.”

🎙 Maharaj at 25:08 (auto-transcript): “But in the sense of aftar, Vidhishthir Maharaj Ji was told by Shri Vidura Mahatma. You are a chatriya. So you know about the physical weapons. They are weapons which are stronger than the physical one. They are more dangerous. Where you are going. Don't sleep like a goat.…”

Maharaj voices her pitch: your body is young, this is the time to enjoy, I am here all for you, it costs you nothing, and I will die if you refuse.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:13 (auto-transcript): “carefully releasing that aros the aros were going to the heart My dear Harida Sakuram, in this whole world, some women are not attracted to this youthful, sweet body. Your body is so young, so fresh.”

She even turns his saintliness into an argument: you are a desire tree, a Vaishnava never disappoints anyone who comes to him — so fulfil my desire too.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:45 (auto-transcript): “You are a desire for falling tree. You are a vashnava. You will never disappoint anyone who comes to you. Bhagavad Gita said, Anything that comes of you is on a chord. It should be accepted. I am killing you on my monochrome. You did not call for me.”

Haridasa says yes. He does not flare up and curse her, as Visvamitra might have; a devotee thinks only how he can help the person in front of him. — “A devotee thinks about the welfare of others.”

🎙 Maharaj at 29:12 (auto-transcript): “Haridash Thakur said yes. He didn't become angry. Like Vishwami Tramoni. You came to pollute me. You prostitute. I curse you. Haridash didn't do like that. He is a devotee. Why a devotee? A devotee thinks about the welfare of others. How can I help this person?”

In Saranagati Bhaktivinoda Thakura is happy whenever someone chants Hare Krishna. Why, if it is not his chanting? Because reclaiming conditioned souls is Krishna's greatest opulence, and pure devotees come to help him in that mission.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:12 (auto-transcript): “In Shalana Gati Shalana Gati Shalana Gati Thakurji says Jain Hare Krishna and those before the desire of Bhakti Thakurji Why? someone chanting Hare Krishna will make him happy. Why? It is not for him. It is for me. Why he is happy? He feels happy because he knows the highest…”

Haridasa saw neither a woman nor an enemy, only a soul Krishna had sent him to deliver. Not belonging to this world, he did not react; he asked her to wait and hear the name. — “Krishna has sent someone for me to deliver.”

🎙 Maharaj at 31:31 (auto-transcript): “So, Haridash Thakurji was happy. He didn't see the woman. He didn't see the enemy. He only saw Krishna has sent someone for me to deliver. Because he is not part of this world, so he didn't react negatively, he was looking at how can I deliver this woman, so he told her to…”

children.topic: The power of the pure name
children.note:
She heard the pure name with an open mind, not offensively waiting for strength to make him fall, and in three nights her impurities disappeared.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:32 (auto-transcript): “While she was hearing the name, the pure name, that is a giant thing, the pure name. And the woman was hearing it with open mind. She was not hearing the offense. Let me hear so I can get more strength to fall him down. She was open and listened to Hertha Sekoula's pure name.…”

children.topic: A pure devotee's name acts differently
children.note:
The name chanted by a pure devotee has a different quality and potency. — “That is the potency of the holy name chanted by a pure devotee.”

🎙 Maharaj at 33:26 (auto-transcript): “That is the potency of the holy name chanted by a pure devotee. Pure devotees, the quality of their name acts differently. Three days, hearing the holy name, she got transformed. That was the purpose of Haidash, staying there for her three days.”

Three days of hearing transformed her; that was the purpose of Haridasa keeping her there.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:54 (auto-transcript): “Three days, hearing the holy name, she got transformed. That was the purpose of Haidash, staying there for her three days. So what happened? Negativity has been made positive. We can do that only if we are positive. Then we can make others positive.”

Haridasa turned negativity into something positive — and we can do that only if we are positive ourselves. Our Krishna consciousness is measured by how many people are transformed, and whose faith grows, in our association. — “Negativity has been made positive.”

🎙 Maharaj at 34:13 (auto-transcript): “So what happened? Negativity has been made positive. We can do that only if we are positive. Then we can make others positive. of our Krishna consciousness is shown by how many people are getting transformed”

It requires purity, being sincere servants of Krishna; then mercy flows to whoever comes in contact with us, and they are transformed.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:14 (auto-transcript): “requires purity that we are sincere servant of Krishna and the mercy is coming whoever comes in our contact And this will happen, whatever will happen to us, it will become transformed. Harada Sekhura has demonstrated it. And the woman became changed. And she was chanting.”

The woman changed and was chanting O my Lord Hari, and Haridasa was happy. May our purpose in Krishna consciousness be fulfilled the same way.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:54 (auto-transcript): “And the woman became changed. And she was chanting. O my Lord, hurry! O my Lord, hurry! Harada became happy. Let our purpose be fulfilled in Krishna Consistency. Hare Krishna. Comments or questions? What is your question? Hare Krishna.”

One question on using Haridasa's method with our own desires.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:25 (auto-transcript): “Comments or questions? What is your question? Hare Krishna. So this approach I tried once like how someone told me, I don't know, maybe you are someone I heard. Like when we get some desire for sensory notification, then tell me, wait, let me complete my sadhana. Then, like…”

children.topic: Q1 · Postponing lust until sadhana ends?
children.note:
A devotee tried telling a desire, wait until I finish my sadhana — but being weak, the thought persisted during sadhana and he acted on it afterwards. What should we do?

🎙 Question from the floor at 36:43 (auto-transcript): “So this approach I tried once like how someone told me, I don't know, maybe you are someone I heard. Like when we get some desire for sensory notification, then tell me, wait, let me complete my sadhana. Then, like this approach with Saritastha God did, let me complete my…”
Chanting is eternal — always chanting, as the Gita says. Haridasa never finished his rounds. — “Chanting is eternal.”

Maharaj retells it: yesterday I could not finish, please excuse me, tonight I surely will — sit and hear the name. Keep chanting the pure name and everything is transformed.

children.topic: Treat the mind the same way
children.note:
That is how we treat the mind: keep chanting and let it hear, and it will start chanting too. If we stop, maya touches us; if we keep on, there is no space for her. — “then Maya will touch us.”

nodeData.note: CC Antya 3.123–124 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. At dawn Haridasa Thakura tells the restless woman that his vow of ten million names is nearly complete. Maharaj draws out seriousness about our own vows, chanting as the sacrifice of the intelligent, and how the holy name lifts anyone regardless of birth. In the questions he weighs japa against kirtan, with Gaura Kisora dasa Babaji's festival of the holy name. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The verse describes the end of the night: the woman sent to tempt Haridasa Thakura is restless, and he begins to speak to her.
Haridasa Thakura explains that he is bound by a vow of chanting that is almost finished.

Maharaj turns the verse to us: we too have taken a vow — to chant sixteen rounds daily.

🎙 Maharaj at 08:28 (auto-transcript): “We have taken vow to chant 16 rounds. What is Haridash Thakura saying? I have taken a vow to chant until I finish my job. I cannot do anything else. Waiting like this. Until I finish my sincing round, I cannot do anything else.”

children.topic: Nothing else until it is done
children.note:
Haridasa's attitude is that he cannot do anything else until his chanting is complete. Maharaj asks us to treat our rounds the same way.

🎙 Maharaj at 08:43 (auto-transcript): “I have taken a vow to chant until I finish my job. I cannot do anything else. Waiting like this. Until I finish my sincing round, I cannot do anything else. Of all the things we do in Krishna Consciousness, we are going to do it for life.”

The vows taken at initiation are for life, so they come before everything else. Maharaj calls this seriousness in Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 09:17 (auto-transcript): “Of all the things we do in Krishna Consciousness, we are going to do it for life. The other thing we took vow for is chanting 16 hours. That means that we should complete our vows before anything else.”

What attracts Maharaj most in the pastime of Lord Varaha and Hiranyaksa is the Lord's seriousness about his mission.

🎙 Maharaj at 10:10 (auto-transcript): “In the past times of Lord Varaha Deo and Hiranyakshita, the first thing that attracted me most, Bhagavan has moved his seriousness in his vow. When he went to the Pluto planet to raise the earth, Hiranyaksha said, this place”

As the Lord went down to raise the earth, Hiranyaksa claimed the region as his own and insulted him, demanding a fight. The Lord heard him but did not stop.

🎙 Maharaj at 10:52 (auto-transcript): “When he went to the Pluto planet to raise the earth, Hiranyaksha said, this place This area is given to us, so you cannot come here and do anything you would like here without facing me. Shri Varaa Deva heard him but he didn't get out of the way”

He lifted the earth back into its orbit, and only after finishing that duty did he turn to Hiranyaksa: now, what were you saying? Only the serious and sincere succeed. — “He did the first thing first.”

🎙 Maharaj at 12:02 (auto-transcript): “He did the first thing first. After finishing his duty, then he told to Hiranyasa, What were you saying? Being serious in our vows. Only devotees who are serious and sincere will succeed. Lord Baradeva taught us to be serious and sincere to our duty.”

Maharaj laughs that the night before he heard a reading from a work by Prabodhananda Sarasvati with the very same words: the sincere and serious will hanker for the dust of Srimati Radharani's lotus feet. Krishna arranges what fits the theme.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:47 (auto-transcript): “Last night, I was listening to a narration. Right from the beginning, it is a book from Prabodhana Svavati. The same topic came here. I was laughing how Krishna arranged everything systematically mentioned the same words”

Those who are not serious compromise — I will do it later. That attitude makes the most important thing small. — “Nothing is more important than the chanting of the holy name of Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 14:51 (auto-transcript): “this is seriousness in Krishna consciousness for those who are not serious compromise I will do it later which means we are minimizing the most important thing Nothing is more important than the chanting of the holy name of Krishna.”

children.topic: Rounds should not wait for us
children.note:
Complete the chanting first and then do other things; this is what Haridasa Thakura is teaching.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:37 (auto-transcript): “Our Sisiñrana should not wait for us. complete it first, then you can do other things, so Haida Sakura is teaching this, so Prabhupada said, if one regularly chant, three hundred and thirty three million three hundred and thirty three names daily for a month”
Maharaj takes up the purport's word for the intelligent: those who are truly intelligent and serious put everything into the sacrifice of chanting.

Recalling Devahuti's words, Maharaj says serious devotees used past lives to prepare; in this life nothing is left for them but the holy name.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:47 (auto-transcript): “Mata Dev Houthi, she said, serious and sincere devotees, they have finished all other activities. The only thing left for them to do is the only thing left for them to do.”

children.topic: The name as a side activity
children.note:
The less intelligent have so many other things to do; for them the holy name is secondary and the unnecessary things come first.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:55 (auto-transcript): “So those are not intelligent. They have so many other activities to do and know the holy name. They are in a lot of lives, but they will not give the holy name of God. Or the holy name is a secondary thing. The primary thing is to do all unnecessary things. So, when we take…”

Look carefully at scripture and then at ourselves and we can see exactly how much attachment each of us has for the name.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:18 (auto-transcript): “So, when we take our scriptures, and look at it very carefully, and look at everybody, you will know where we are individually. We can know everybody by looking at our scriptures, and we will know exactly who is who, how much”

children.topic: Nothing between me and the name
children.note:
Such devotees feel they cannot spare attention even for trivial things; nothing comes between them and the name, not even prasada. Maharaj calls them fortunate and intelligent. — “nothing comes in between me and the name”

🎙 Maharaj at 21:34 (auto-transcript): “Such devotees, they would think, I cannot afford to change bad nails. I will not give attention to the name, and nothing comes in between me and the name, and nothing comes in between me and the name, not even prasad, Fortunate source. Intelligent. According to external…”

children.topic: The name makes one a brahmana
children.note:
Though Haridasa Thakura was born in a Muslim family, his chanting made him a true brahmana. Maharaj illustrates this with Rupa and Anupama meeting Vallabha Bhatta.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:18 (auto-transcript): “According to external vision, Haridah Sakura belonged to a Muslim family. Nevertheless, because he engaged himself in performing the Jagia of chanting the Hare Krishna Maha Matras, he became a regularly initiated Brahmana. When Salatan, Koshrami and Anupa, Rupa and Anupa,…”

children.topic: Rupa and Anupama refuse a touch
children.note:
Mahaprabhu arranged for the brothers to meet a proud, learned brahmana. When he wanted to embrace them they ran back, saying they were untouchable and he was an exalted brahmana; Mahaprabhu agreed — do not touch them.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:52 (auto-transcript): “When Salatan, Koshrami and Anupa, Rupa and Anupa, they came to see Dhamma in a lab, He met with a very powerful brahmana.”
Looking at them, he saw they were constantly vibrating the maha-mantra and concluded they were pure souls whose touch would purify him. — “How can they be untouchable?”
Maharaj recalls the Bhagavatam's words: one born among dog-eaters becomes worshipable when the name is on his tongue. That is the potency of the holy name.

children.topic: Bhakti does not depend on birth
children.note:
Mahaprabhu took Haridasa from a Muslim family and made him the namacarya. Anyone, from anywhere, can become a devotee.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:16 (auto-transcript): “So Chaitanya Mahapu selected Haridas. from Muslim family to making Nama Acharya. He took Prahlad Ji from demonic society, pure devotee. He took Hanuman Ji from animalism, pure devotee.”

Prahlada came from a demonic family, Hanuman from the animal kingdom, and Rupa, Sanatana and Raghunatha dasa Gosvamis from wealth and high government posts — all pure devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:40 (auto-transcript): “He took Prahlad Ji from demonic society, pure devotee. He took Hanuman Ji from animalism, pure devotee. Shri Rupa Satang Goswami and Raghu Nath Dash Goswami they took them from Kayayst and they were posHigh company money people money they were some big positions put them from…”
Since Krishna is the father of every living being, bhakti does not depend on external situations. It is not difficult.

children.topic: If a touchstone can, why not spirit?
children.note:
Maharaj quizzes the room: a touchstone turns iron into gold — is it material or spiritual? Material. If matter has such power, how easy it is for the spiritual name to transform anyone.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:26 (auto-transcript): “material object, like what? Material object, like what? Treat my mind. You are not connected. Toaston. Toaston is not material. Toaston. It can transform iron into gold. Is it material or spiritual? Material. She has that power. What about the spiritual?”

Maharaj contrasts Haridasa's vast daily chanting with a man of good birth whose count was zero — a blasphemer of devotees, whom Mahaprabhu struck with leprosy. Haridasa was no offender; he was a pure devotee, so learn from him.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:32 (auto-transcript): “Shaila Haydash Thakur Ji was a Muslim, but he became a namachar Haidash Thakur. Shaila Haydash Thakur Ji had 3,000,000 names. How many? How many? How many? How many? How many? How many? How many? How many? How many? How many? How many? Zero. Thank you. Zero. Zero. Zero. Not…”

For the serious: no prasada before sixteen rounds — prasada can wait, the rounds cannot. For the very serious: no discussion and no sleep before the rounds are done.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:21 (auto-transcript): “Therefore we should learn from him that no sixteen round no prasada for those who are serious for those who are serious prasada no sixteen round she see and can wait But prasad can continue to go on. Those who are very, very serious No sissin and no prasad”

One question from a devotee.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:27 (auto-transcript): “Comments? Thank you very much, Raj, for the lecture. So my question is as regards the chanting of the Holy Name. When we say chanting of the Holy Name, it could be Japa, which you are emphasizing here in this class. And it could be San Kirtan, performing of Kirtan in the…”

children.topic: Q1 · Japa or kirtan: which higher?
children.note:
Some say they do little japa but much kirtan, others the reverse. Both are the holy name — is one higher, or can one replace the other?

🎙 Question from the floor at 34:38 (auto-transcript): “So my question is as regards the chanting of the Holy Name. When we say chanting of the Holy Name, it could be Japa, which you are emphasizing here in this class. And it could be San Kirtan, performing of Kirtan in the presence of devotees. So, So, is there a hierarchy…”

In Caitanya-caritamrta, after his morning duties and his own rounds, Mahaprabhu then took his devotees out for harinama. The personal chanting comes first.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:20 (auto-transcript): “What we saw in the Chaitanya Chaitanya Vita is that Krishnadas Kaviraj Goswami described. After finishing his body duties, what is that? 16 rounds. Then, Bhagavan Chaitanya Mahaprabhu took his devotees to Harinam. The first is what is our 16th Malakaljabh.”

Lead a kirtan with music and many people gather and sit for hours; sit to chant japa and how many stay with you? It is the potent sound bringing them, Maharaj says. — “It is not your pure chanting.”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:47 (auto-transcript): “You have a lot of followers. So many people gather you. Is it not? Is it not true? If you do jump, how many people will be there with you? How many people? So, you understand? What is bringing the many disciples? It is not your pure chanting.”

Gaura Kisora dasa Babaji invited everyone to a festival. They came expecting a kitchen, a stage and feasts, but he announced a festival of the holy name — no rice, no dal — and chanted with eyes closed until morning. When he opened them, only a handful remained.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:45 (auto-transcript): “Guru Kishore Dabhaji Maharaj He told his disciples invite the devotees to come for a festival. So thousands of people will gather. The servant informed him. Baba Ji Maharaj. People have come for the festival. But he didn't, when he said festival, he was looking at the bhogas…”

Asked how to make kirtan attractive to people, Prabhupada answered: do not chant to attract people. If Krishna is pleased, that is kirtan. — “Chant to please Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 45:11 (auto-transcript): “A devotee had asked Prabhupada the question. How do we make our kirtan attractive for people? Prabhupada said, don't chant to attract people. Chant to please Krishna. If Krishna is pleased, that is Kirtan. So, we do vows to do 16 months. My zoom on two hours. We can do Hainam…”

We may do harinama for ten hours, but there is no vow for that; our vow is sixteen rounds. So the rounds come first, and the strength for kirtan comes from them.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:41 (auto-transcript): “So, we do vows to do 16 months. My zoom on two hours. We can do Hainam for ten hours. That is a different thing. There is no vow for that. But we did not have Pratigya. We had Pratigya for 16 months. That means that in our lives, 16 months, after that, something will come.…”

nodeData.note: CC Antya 3.125–136 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Over three nights of hearing Haridasa Thakura chant, the woman sent by Ramacandra Khan is purified, confesses, and asks him to be her guru; he tells her to give all her property to brahmanas. Maharaj dwells on Haridasa seeing only a chance to serve, the torch-and-sun image for those who try to harm a pure devotee, charity to the qualified rather than to so-called daridra-narayana, and why a simple, sincere heart changes faster than a crooked one. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Haridasa Thakura tells the woman he chanted all night and still did not finish, but tomorrow his vow will surely be complete. The purport explains that his real intent was to let her hear the holy name.

From the Gita verse quoted in the purport, Maharaj picks out one word for the room: determination.

🎙 Maharaj at 08:09 (auto-transcript): “What? Determination. Vahavashya Ramachandrakhan ke paas laut gai The prostitute returned to Ramachandra Khan and informed him of what had happened.”

These verses tell how she reports back to Ramacandra Khan, returns earlier the next evening, bows to Tulasi and to Haridasa, and sits on the threshold hearing him chant — and begins to chant herself — until the night ends and her mind is changed.
Purified, she falls at his feet and confesses the plot, and Haridasa says he already knew of it.
The verse tells why Haridasa remained in that place three more days.
When she asks him to be her spiritual master, his first instruction is about her property; the purport discusses whom charity should go to.

Haridasa could have seen only trouble. Instead he saw an opportunity for service.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:05 (auto-transcript): “Haridash Thakura will have trouble but he saw that a chance is coming for him to do the western service. Haridash was not thinking about himself. He was thinking about the opportunity for him to serve God. He was thinking about the opportunity for him to serve God.”

Haridasa was not concerned with his own safety or reputation; he was thinking of the opportunity to serve the Lord.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:35 (auto-transcript): “Haridash was not thinking about himself. He was thinking about the opportunity for him to serve God. He was thinking about the opportunity for him to serve God. Shilakkabhi Karnapur Goswami Ji says, A true devotee. Where there is a chance for service. This is a chance for me…”

Citing Kavi Karnapura, Maharaj says a true devotee sees, wherever there is a chance for service, a chance to be purified.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:53 (auto-transcript): “Shilakkabhi Karnapur Goswami Ji says, A true devotee. Where there is a chance for service. This is a chance for me to get purified, and they will do the service, as Krishna said, Krishna is saying here, Madharpanam, that is service. Unto me,”
Krishna asks that everything be done as an offering to him. Every activity of a devotee becomes that offering.

So a real devotee keeps examining what he is offering. — “He will check what is the quality of my offerings to Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 26:56 (auto-transcript): “So a true devotee, He will check what is the quality of my offerings to Krishna. He was not afraid of Ramachandrakhan. He said he is an ignorant fool. So, Hadash Thakur was not even seeing his foolishness. He was looking at his foolishness. If you point a torch”

children.topic: A torch pointed at the sun
children.note:
Haridasa was not afraid of Ramacandra Khan and simply called him an ignorant fool; the plot had no power over him.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:12 (auto-transcript): “He was not afraid of Ramachandrakhan. He said he is an ignorant fool. So, Hadash Thakur was not even seeing his foolishness. He was looking at his foolishness. If you point a torch to this sound, does it have any effect? Does it have any effect? Does it have any effect?”

children.topic: Does a torch affect the sun?
children.note:
Maharaj asks the room: if you shine a torch at the sun, does it have any effect? A pure devotee is like the sun; Ramacandra Khan and the woman were like torches. — “The sun is billions of times greater than the torch light.”

🎙 Maharaj at 27:39 (auto-transcript): “If you point a torch to this sound, does it have any effect? Does it have any effect? Does it have any effect? Why? The sun is billions of times greater than the torch light. So a devotee is like the sun. Ramachand Khan is like torch.”

If what people do to us shakes us, it shows how empty we still are inside.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:26 (auto-transcript): “what effect do they have for pure dignity if we are affected by the things people do to us if we are affected we are empty that we are empty Krishna is very kind. He is using the torches to teach us what is happening with us.”

children.topic: See the Lord, not the instrument
children.note:
Krishna kindly uses such 'torches' to teach us, but we look at the instrument and miss the cause. Haridasa did not see Ramacandra Khan or the woman; he saw the Supreme Lord sending her to be purified.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:53 (auto-transcript): “Krishna is very kind. He is using the torches to teach us what is happening with us. But we don't see that. We see the instrument we don't see the course. Haridash Thakur Ji He doesn't see the instrument Ramachandr Khan Ramachandr Khan”

Haridasa postponed his travel only to deliver her. He knew it would take three days, so he stayed and chanted for three days.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:01 (auto-transcript): “Just to deliver you, I did not travel. I waited. I know it would take me three days to purify you. So I stayed for three days. And I chanted the name for three days. I have done my duty. Now I have done my duty. I can travel. She told the prostitutes. Go and distribute your…”

children.topic: Duty done, now he can go
children.note:
Having done his duty, he was free to travel on, after sending her to give away her ill-gotten property and come back.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:22 (auto-transcript): “I have done my duty. Now I have done my duty. I can travel. She told the prostitutes. Go and distribute your ill and property and money to the brahmanas. Go and distribute your ill and property and money to the brahmanas. and he come back here see as Haridash would initiate…”

Her own chanting of Hari was the fruit of Haridasa's japa. His chanting was pure, so it worked automatically.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:41 (auto-transcript): “And now, she responded. Hari! Hari! Hari! That's the result of Hareda Sikora's Japa. It is pure. It worked automatically. Three days. Not three years. that is the potential of his name this holy name works according to our purity”

children.topic: The name works by our purity
children.note:
Three days, not three years: that is the potency of the name. So we should learn how to chant; then we will experience what is happening. — “this holy name works according to our purity”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:04 (auto-transcript): “Not three years. that is the potential of his name this holy name works according to our purity So we should learn how to change the holy name, then we will experience what is taking place.”

Haridasa told her to give to brahmanas, not to the so-called poor Narayana.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:59 (auto-transcript): “He had his access to go and distribute her properties to Brahmanas, not to Darid Narayanans. Narayan cannot be poor person, and Darid cannot be Narayan. So Prabhupada said, this is a contradiction. How can Narayan be poor? He owns everything. Narayan owns everything.”

If he is poor he is not Narayana, and the poor are not Narayana; so give to qualified people. — “How can Narayan be poor?”

🎙 Maharaj at 33:25 (auto-transcript): “So Prabhupada said, this is a contradiction. How can Narayan be poor? He owns everything. Narayan owns everything. If he's poor, he's not Narayan. So Harada told him not to give it to the Narayan people. Give it to qualify people. Brahmanas, sanyasi.”

children.topic: No sannyasi with a bank account
children.note:
A sannyasi with personal money is not a sannyasi but an unfortunate enjoyer using the dress to exploit — a thief. Charity to such a person brings no benefit. — “Not a sanyasi who has bank account.”

🎙 Maharaj at 34:22 (auto-transcript): “Not a sanyasi who has bank account. Sanyasi has a personal money, it's not a sanyasi, it's a boogie, unfortunate boogie, will not exploit unfortunate boogie use the dress to exploit”

children.topic: Charity is never to be given up
children.note: Krishna says in the Gita that charity should not be abandoned; it is so powerful it purifies even sages.

children.topic: Give to the qualified, gain fully
children.note:
Given to a qualified brahmana or sannyasi, charity brings promotion toward God; given to a pure devotee, the full result.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:14 (auto-transcript): “Daridra if he is given to qualified brahman qualified sanyasi you get promotion to godhead if you give to pure devotee you get 100% results therefore it is specifically mentioned here It should not be given to Darida Narayana, but it should be given to qualified, sincere…”
Maharaj walks through the qualities: peaceful, self-controlled, austere, clean within and without, tolerant, straightforward, with realised knowledge. Charity to such a person surely purifies.

He asks what astikyam means and explains it as fixedness — a steady practitioner whom nothing can shake.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:21 (auto-transcript): “Ashtikyam. What is that? Ashtikyam is what? He is. Fixedness is fixed. So he is a steady practitioner. Not still can change him. these are the qualities”

Haridasa did not tell her to give to just anyone, and she was utterly sincere in carrying out his word.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:36 (auto-transcript): “And the prostitute was so, so sincere. When the Guru said, go and distribute everything and come back here. It means what? She becomes a poor mendicant. It means a very poor mendicant. Shadhui is a sadhu. Shadhui is a woman.”

Distributing everything and returning meant becoming a poor mendicant, a sadhvi — simply a lady devoted to the Lord.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:58 (auto-transcript): “It means what? She becomes a poor mendicant. It means a very poor mendicant. Shadhui is a sadhu. Shadhui is a woman. Shadhui is a woman. Shadhui is a woman. Simply a lady. Shadhui is a woman. So Harvya Sekura is teaching the process of becoming successful in Krishna…”

Haridasa teaches the process of success: no dependence on material things, no attachment, freedom, and dependence on Krishna alone. — “Our shelter shouldn't be with material facilities.”

🎙 Maharaj at 40:31 (auto-transcript): “So Harvya Sekura is teaching the process of becoming successful in Krishna consciousness. No depending on material things. Our shelter shouldn't be with material facilities. No attachment. Freedom. To depend only on Krishna.”

She accepted it and the guru initiated her. Today guru and disciple are often different, Maharaj says; the guru teaches selflessness and pure bhakti.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:32 (auto-transcript): “Like Guru, like disciple. This day, Guru and Disciple are different. Guru is teaching selflessness. Teaching pure bhakti. We sit down, the body in the class, the mind yourself on the outside of the class.”

The body sits in class while the mind is outside. Dress, books and surroundings change, yet the heart does not, because the hearing does not enter.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:13 (auto-transcript): “We sit down, the body in the class, the mind yourself on the outside of the class. So, we are hearing, the heart is not changing. Look at the faces. The heart is not changing. Dress is changed, maybe the scripture is also changed, the environment is changing, the”

We block the mercy by clinging to stories we have enjoyed since time immemorial and drawing nourishment from them.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:17 (auto-transcript): “We are blocking the mercy because we are holding to, we are enjoying our narratives which we have been associating with this time immemorial. We are enjoying it, so we are holding to that, therefore the real thing in the Christian Consciousness is not enter. Because we are…”

Why did she change in three days? She was simple; we are crooked and do not yet want to change. — “a sincere prostitute was better than a sophisticated, crooked man”

🎙 Maharaj at 44:01 (auto-transcript): “A prostitute change. Why? Why? this is a simple person we are crooked we are crooked therefore the message is not entering because we don't want to change yet we should change if we want to be successful let's give a We should create a space for Krishna to come in.”

We must create room for Krishna to come in and give him a chance to cleanse us; otherwise we are only imitating Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:36 (auto-transcript): “We should create a space for Krishna to come in. Otherwise, we are simply making sure of Krishna Consciousness. No, we should get the real Krishna. when we are tired of suffering. But this is when we are up to this world. We will give Krishna a chance to do the cleansing.”

Open the door to Krishna and do not stay a hypocrite: every day may seem to belong to the hypocrite, but one day is Krishna's, and the price is paid.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:03 (auto-transcript): “Let us open the door for Krishna to come in and not remain hypocrites because hypocrites you pay the price one day not order this only one day hypocrite yes you pay the price one day every day is for the hypocrites one day is for krishna”
